posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
I didn't post this earlier since it was speculation at the time, but the community has determined the Freedom Five prerequisite games:
 
First, the Prime Wardens (all variant members) must be defeated by Progeny anywhere other than Rook City or Megalopolis. Then, Dark Watch (all variant members) must by defeated by Progeny in Rook City. Then, the Freedom Five (non-variant members) must be defeated by Progeny in Rook City.
 
Credit to bolnerap & NinjaMonkey for getting on the right track early!
 
https://greaterthangames.com/comment/181276#comment-181276
https://greaterthangames.com/comment/181702#comment-181702
 
Note: there is a bug in the second game check that allows a 5th non-Dark Watch team member; this will be fixed in an update.
